text.p: Top 10 films showing at Dutch cinemas (pvs week in brackets)
1 (3) THE ENGLISH PATIENT - Romantic epic period piece. This
year's Academy Award winner.
2 (1) STAR WARS - The re-released version of this now classic
sci-fi space adventure.
3 (1) METRO - Eddie Murphy as Axel Foley-type hero cop for San
Francisco Metropolitan Police.
4 (4) 101 DALMATIONS - Pongo and Perdita take on fur-loving
Cruella De Vil in re-make of Disney classic.
5 (5) JERRY MAGUIRE - Top sports agent, Oscar-nominated Tom
Cruise, decides his personal convictions are more
important than his career.
6 (6) SPACE JAM - Bugs Bunny and Looney Tunes gang team up with
U.S. basketball idol Michael Jordan for game against a
group of animated aliens.
7 (7) FIERCE CREATURES - A Fish Called Wanda cast return to
save local British zoo from multinational conglomerate.
8 (8) ROMEO & JULIET - Shakespeare's classic in modern setting.
9 (10) SHINE - Story of troubled concert pianist David Helgott.
Geoffrey Rush won Academy Award for best actor.
10(13) RANSOM - Mel Gibson turns tables on his son's kidnappers
in emotional drama.
Source: Nederlandse Federatie voor Cinematografie.
Following is a selection of films PREMIERING this week:
THE DEVIL'S OWN - Policeman Harrison Ford unwittingly befriends
IRA terrorist Brad Pitt and later has to hunt him down.
HUFTERS & HOFDAMES - Independent Dutch film portraying young
man's desire to be a macho ladies man.
